component.name: Centurion
component.summary: Power, fan, undervolt and lighting control for Lenovo Legion laptops
Lenovo Legion dizüstüler için güç, fan, undervolt ve aydınlatma denetimi

description.p: One tray app for Lenovo Legion laptops: power profiles, firmware power limits, fan curves, CPU and GPU undervolting, per-key RGB, game-aware system tuning and Scenes that switch all of it at once. Privileged work runs in small validating helpers; there is no telemetry.
